VR.title: Immersed Says It’s Finally Getting Ready to Ship ‘Visor’ VR Headset
VR.summary: Immersed is set to ship its long-awaited Visor VR headset, focusing on work applications, with shipping timelines confirmed for next month.

VR.title: Mixed Reality Tower Defense Game Cybercore Protocol Out Now In Early Access On Quest
VR.summary: Cybercore Protocol, a new mixed reality tower defense game, has launched in Early Access on Quest, offering players a unique gameplay experience.

VR.title: Roboquest VR Launches Today On Quest 3 Along With Cross-Platform Co-Op
VR.summary: Roboquest VR is now available on Quest 3, featuring a new cross-platform co-op mode that enhances multiplayer gameplay.

VR.title: Meta Horizon+ now includes Xbox Game Pass at no extra cost
VR.summary: Meta Horizon+ has added over 50 Xbox Game Pass titles at no extra cost, enhancing its value for Quest owners.

VR.title: Futuristic VR FPS Hyper Dash Shutting Down This November
VR.summary: Triangle Factory announced the shutdown of its futuristic VR FPS Hyper Dash, effective this November.

VR.title: VR Action Platformer Hyperstacks Coming To SteamVR This Week
VR.summary: The VR action platformer Hyperstacks will launch on Steam and Meta Quest on July 30, promising colorful combat and parkour.

AI.title: Anthropic releases Opus 5 with ‘close’ to Fable 5’s capabilities
AI.summary: Anthropic has released its latest AI model, Claude Opus 5, which approaches the capabilities of its predecessor, Claude Fable 5.

AI.title: Nvidia, Microsoft launch open AI security alliance — without OpenAI, Google, or Anthropic
AI.summary: Nvidia and Microsoft have formed an Open Secure AI Alliance to create open-source AI security tools, excluding major players like OpenAI and Google.

AI.title: Why China is giving away its best AI models
AI.summary: China's Moonshot AI has introduced the Kimi K3 model, reportedly outperforming top US AI systems at a lower cost, escalating tech competition.

AI.title: Microsoft unveils AI security tools it says outperform competing platforms
AI.summary: Microsoft has unveiled new AI security tools that claim to outperform competitors while being more cost-effective.

AI.title: Meta is making its AI chatbot more like an assistant
AI.summary: Meta is enhancing its AI chatbot with new productivity features to better compete with rivals like ChatGPT and Claude.

AI.title: Alexa Plus is getting an AI update to handle more complicated instructions
AI.summary: Amazon is updating its Alexa Plus assistant to handle more complex smart home instructions, expanding its connectivity options.

NFL.title: Dolphins sign free agent DE Clelin Ferrell
NFL.summary: The Dolphins have signed veteran free agent defensive end Clelin Ferrell, bolstering their defensive line.

NFL.title: Titans announce Nazeeh Johnson signing, waive CB Latrell McCutchin
NFL.summary: The Titans have officially signed cornerback Nazeeh Johnson while waiving CB Latrell McCutchin to adjust their roster.

NFL.title: Giants worked out LB Kenneth Murray, 17 others, on Monday
NFL.summary: The Giants worked out linebacker Kenneth Murray and 17 other players on Monday as they prepare for the upcoming season.

NFL.title: Colts place WR Alec Pierce, LB CJ Allen on active/PUP
NFL.summary: The Colts have placed wide receiver Alec Pierce and linebacker CJ Allen on the active/physically unable to perform list.

NFL.title: Daniel Jones says he still has some work to do before Week 1 but is fully cleared
NFL.summary: Colts quarterback Daniel Jones has been cleared for training camp but acknowledges he still has work to do before Week 1.

NFL.title: NFLPA scraps "60-day rule" that allowed agents to solicit players who have representation
NFL.summary: The NFL Players Association has eliminated the '60-day rule,' allowing agents to solicit players who already have representation.
